title: Nuit Interop
description: Nuit Interoperability for OptiFine/MCPatcher and legacy FabricSkyBoxes sky formats
body:
# Nuit Interop

_Formerly known as **FabricSkyBoxes Interop**_

**Nuit Interop** adds compatibility for **OptiFine/MCPatcher custom skies**, allowing existing resource packs to work with [Nuit](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit), the modern multiloader successor to FabricSkyBoxes.

It converts supported OptiFine custom sky definitions to Nuit’s skybox format at runtime, making many existing sky resource packs work out of the box.

---

## Features

- **OptiFine/MCPatcher Custom Sky Support**  
  Converts supported `optifine/sky` resource-pack definitions into Nuit-compatible skyboxes.

- **Smart Fallback**  
  Skips conversion when native Nuit/FabricSkyBoxes-format skyboxes are already present.

- **Flexible Control**  
  Includes options for disabling native Nuit-format skyboxes when testing or preferring converted skies.

- **Legacy FabricSkyBoxes Support**  
  Planned support for loading legacy FabricSkyBoxes-format packs directly.

---

## Requirements

- [Nuit](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit)

---

## Notes

Conversion is best-effort. Some packs may not render pixel-perfectly because OptiFine/MCPatcher and Nuit handle sky rendering differently.
